items.label: 最高纲领派
items.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE complete transparent historical strategy-game adviser faction icon: a deliberately DESIGNED TYPOGRAPHIC EMBLEM made from exactly four uppercase Cyrillic letters С С Р М (ССРМ). The attached image is ONLY a reference for luminous GOLD palette and restrained painted metal rendering, NOT for its typesetting or composition. CRITICAL: visual design must come from DIFFERENT LETTER SIZES, OBLIQUE LETTERFORMS, STAGGERED BASELINES, overlapping and tightly fitted negative spaces, NOT fancy font curls or ordinary evenly spaced text. Use an asymmetric compact ascending-diagonal composition: a dominant large first С anchors the left; a clearly separate second С is smaller and raised; a tall Р rises near the middle-right, and a strong angular М locks into its lower-right. All four letters share a purposeful 12-degree forward slant and are nested into a unified dynamic nearly-square silhouette. Preserve left-to-right reading order С-С-Р-М while allowing vertical offsets. Some serifs and cross strokes may meet, but all four letter shapes and their openings must remain identifiable. Broad confident wedge-like serifs and clean Russian early-twentieth-century poster/letterpress forms; no thin filigree, no decorative swirls. This should look like a custom revolutionary-era printer's monogram, not a word typed in a fancy font. High overall brightness, pale ivory-gold broad faces, shallow amber engraved cuts, subtle satin painted metal, very little deep extrusion. Designed to read as a unique symbol at 20x20 pixels on a dark UI. Letters alone, no badge frame, backing, book, flag, tool, star, crown, underline or extra letters. SQUARE canvas with the complete artwork filling 84 percent of width/height and an 8 percent transparent margin. Genuine transparent background. Return one finished complete icon.

items.label: 孟什维克
items.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Completely redesign the Russian Menshevik adviser icon as a SYMBOL-FORMING CYRILLIC LIGATURE, inspired by how the tiny CGT emblem in reference image 2 transforms letters into a graphic resembling workers' tools. Reference 1 is the rejected old icon: retain ONLY its bright yellow-gold palette, discard its separate typeset letters, wedge arrangement, thick bevels and typography. Reference 2 is the conceptual visual reference: learn its compact interlocking symbolic construction, do NOT copy the CGT letters. Required letter content: exactly Cyrillic Р С Д Р П (РСДРП). CREATE A SINGLE INTEGRATED TOOL-LIKE GLYPH FROM THESE LETTER STROKES. Specific design: a large open С becomes the outer sweeping crescent on the left and curls upward; the long diagonal stems of the two Р overlap into one strong rising tool-handle axis with their two small open bowls nested at different heights; the broad horizontal lintel and short uprights of П lock across the upper-right of that diagonal like a hammer head; the angular shoulders and two feet of Д form the compact triangular lower anchor, sharing a cross stroke with the diagonal. Thus the overall silhouette first reads as a unified abstract workers' emblem, reminiscent of crossed hammer/crescent tools, and only on closer viewing reveals the five letter forms. This is typographic symbolism, not five letters placed around an added tool. Shared strokes, interwoven positive/negative spaces, no gaps separating five individual text characters, no separate words or rows. Maintain a distinct C-shaped negative space and two P bowls where possible, but prioritize a striking coherent 20x20-pixel silhouette. Early-20th-century labour-union printer's insignia, confident simple geometric curved and straight strokes, asymmetrical balanced compact mark. Avoid calligraphic curls, ornate serifs, luxury jewelry, giant stock-font capitals, stacked text. Bright matte golden yellow with pale ivory-gold broad faces and a very shallow engraved amber shadow, restrained historical-game painted metal, NOT thick 3D extrusion or heavy grunge. The whole mark is made ONLY from the letter strokes: no actual added hammer, sickle, star, flag, wreath, enclosing frame, circle or backing. Genuine transparent background. Square canvas, complete emblem centered and occupying 84 percent, safe transparent margin. One complete finished icon.

Strong old Russian newspaper masthead and engraved letterpress inspiration, flowing yet architectural, distinctive thick curved serifs and beautifully shaped negative spaces. Gold letters alone create the full emblem; no round/rectangular backing, frame, flag, handshake, pen, star, crown or extra objects. Luminous bright yellow GOLD with broad pale gold faces, shallow amber engraved shadows and subtle painted-metal historical-game finish, not cute, not a glossy 3D logo.
